body: Epistemic reasons sanction propositions in ways that advance our interest in believing truths and avoiding belief in falsehoods on matters of concern. Regress problems afflict a proper subset of epistemic reasons: evidence-providing reasons.
. What distinguishes the different kinds of evidence-providing reasons from one another is the additional conditions they must satisfy—being nonarbitrary, being reliably produced, et cetera.
